interpretations.statement: Small businesses supplying the sector saw more work.
interpretations.rationale: The production series is the only quantity the material carries, and the reading extends it to the suppliers behind it.

interpretations.statement: Contractors to the sector will see sustained demand.
interpretations.rationale: The published series is national and corroborated, so the demand it records is read forward.

limits.text: The published series measures producers, not the businesses around them.
